{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''Oasis Gas Pipeline''' is an operating natural gas pipeline in Texas, United States.<ref name=source1>[http://bit.ly/2lWcvjz Oasis Gas Pipeline,] Energy Transfer Partners website, accessed September 2017</ref> A modernization project for the mainline is under construction as of October 2022.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/data.php#pipelines|title=Natural Gas Data - U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA)|website=www.eia.gov|access-date=2022-10-11}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from the Waha Gas Plant near Pecos, Texas, across the state.

|lines=31.310983, -103.106007:30.890149, -102.880226:30.701405, -101.825538:30.299540, -99.319330:29.742183, -98.098331:29.780017, -97.317544:29.942010, -96.574459:29.800767, -95.859284|center=30.299540, -99.319330|width=400|height=300|type=normal|zoom=5}}

==Background==
The Oasis pipeline, a natural gas pipeline, is 36 inches in diameter. With a capacity of 1.2 Bcf/d, the pipeline is interconnected with other pipeline systems, power plants, processing facilities, municipalities, and producers.<ref>[http://opletconnect.energytransfer.com/ipost/OPL/capacity/design-capacity-for-intrastates Oasis Pipeline,] Energy Transfer Oplet Connect, Accessed 9 January 2018</ref>
